headline: Northbridge 1–1 Southport

paragraphs.text: Northbridge and Southport finished level at 1–1 when the final whistle arrived at 90+4:30.  Alves brought Southport level at 90+1:57.
Turner put Northbridge ahead at 25:13, making it 1–0. 4 cautions were recorded during this passage. The half-time whistle came at 45:00.

Northbridge declared a switch from 4-3-3 to 4-2-3-1 at 45:00. At 60:23, Southport brought on Duarte for Silva. At 60:40, Northbridge brought on Ellis for Vale. Alves brought Southport level at 90+1:57, making it 1–1. 3 cautions were recorded during this passage. A minimum of 4 minutes was added to the second half, which ended at 90+4:30.
